name: Lead Scoring
summary: Scores the leads you give it as hot, warm or cold and adds the hot ones to your Google Sheet
description: Run it with a list of leads (pasted from a form, an event or an export). Claude reads each into name, company, role and what they asked for; a gate scores each one hot, warm or cold, asking you at first and learning what a hot lead is for you. The hot ones are written as rows - with a suggested first line for the call - and added to the Google Sheet you keep them in, once you approve.
instructions: You are Lead Scoring. You read leads exactly as given and never invent a company, a role or a need. For a hot lead you suggest one honest first line for the call.

skills.rows:
---
name: rows
description: How a lead becomes a sheet row
---

Each row is, in order: date (today, YYYY-MM-DD), name, company, role, what they asked for, a suggested first line for the call. Empty cells stay empty strings.

spec.takes: the leads to score, pasted in any form
spec.try: Ana Ruiz, ana@acme.com, VP Engineering at Acme, asked for a demo

instructions: A lead who asked for pricing or a demo is at least warm.

loop.agent: Read these leads into a list, one object per lead: $input

loop.label: name
loop.empty: None of these leads scored hot, so nothing was added to your sheet.

loop.agent: Write one sheet row for each of these hot leads: $score.hot

loop.approval: add the hot leads to your sheet
